Connect by USB

1. Connect your phone to the PC with a data-capable USB cable.

2. In Android Settings, turn on USB tethering (usually under Hotspot & tethering). USB debugging is not needed.

3. Keep WinDock running on Windows, then return here and tap Find USB PC.

If Windows asks, allow WinDock on your trusted USB network. Tethering may also share your mobile data with Windows; disable mobile data if you do not want that.

This USB attempt stays on the cable. Choose Connect by Wi-Fi for wireless. Reopening the app without a USB link returns to Wi-Fi.

Screen off

At a timed limit, the dock goes black and allows Android to turn the screen off. Your phone’s screen timeout may add a delay. Tap to return while the screen is still on; after it sleeps, use your normal wake control.
Lower brightness and screen breaks reduce display wear. These options cannot guarantee that burn-in will never happen. Stay awake keeps the display on only while this dock is visible.
